```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample data
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 500]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Add tier column with conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then("gold").otherwise("standard")
)

# Convert back and display
result = nw.to_native(df)
print(result)
```
